channel.title: Junior Baking Show
channel.desc: It's Pastry Day, and the first heat of junior bakers tackle two tricky tasks; for the Technical, they must stay on track with a train-themed choux challenge; then, for the Showstopper, the bakers create pastry portraits of their favorite pop stars; who can stay on track to be named Star Baker?
